title: 1987 Topps - Turn Back the Clock #312 Reggie Jackson Baseball NY Yankees
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: A 1987 Topps Reggie Jackson trading card from the Turn Back the Clock set, featuring the New York Yankees baseball team. This autographed card is part of the Tiffany parallel/variety and showcases Reggie Jackson in his baseball career with the Yankees. It is a sports trading card manufactured by Topps and is part of the Major League Baseball (MLB) league.
